recommendedDirection: Option 3 (hybrid): one-time real `git merge cli-1.1.10` now to establish merge lineage (cheap: HEAD already has the selective intake, resolution is take-ours-dominant) -> flip cadence to per-release `git merge` -> incrementally R8-overlay the UI surface + fork-own new/index.tsx -> accept ~a dozen convergent sync-core files as permanent catalogued manual-3-way.

throwawayMergeConflicts.note: 115 > catalogued ~96/103 because no merge lineage exists yet, so git re-derives across all 213 upstream commits from the ancient base df4cdae8, re-conflicting files the ordinary-commit selective intake already reconciled.

lineageArgument.withoutLineage: merge-base stuck at df4cdae8; every future selective intake re-derives the full ~115-file surface forever.
lineageArgument.withLineage: after one committed merge, merge-base advances to cli-1.1.10; next merge (upstream-happy/main = 3 commits / 7 files) surfaces only the incremental delta.

packages/happy-app/sources/sync/storage..reason: single Zustand create() closure; app consumes internal methods by name; convergent pagination + tree-grouping vs unread; deleted multi-account state.

packages/happy-app/sources/sync/sync.ts.reason: single Sync class; divergence is removals (multi-account, per-session E2E) + body-replacements (loopback fetchMachines, no-decrypt fetch); no upstream seam to overlay against.

packages/happy-app/sources/app/(app)/new.reason: leaf UI screen; adopt upstream file + move fork lean e-ink screen to sources/fork/newSession/ behind a route flag; removes it from the conflict set; cost ~M.

packages/happy-cli/src/utils/MessageQueu.reason: standalone util; delivery-ack additive (wrappable), attachment-by-ref type replacement threaded through batch bodies (manual); catalogue as HC-8.

codexModelGap: codex is rebasable because upstream openai/codex exposes provider/trait/plugin seams the fork implements in 7 overlay crates + a submodule on a small sandbox-patches branch. Upstream happy's sync plane is a monolithic Sync class + Zustand store with NO extension seams, so there is nowhere to hang an overlay without editing the file (=the conflict) or landing seam PRs upstream. Happy already copied the codex *mechanics* (overlay dirs, markers, catalogue) for UI/server/cli; the sync core is the irreducible gap.
operatorDecisionCalls: Stay vendored (recommended) vs migrate to submodule — lineage, not a submodule, is what enables rebasability.
Minimal upfront investment (recommended: just the lineage merge) vs big-bang overlay rewrite (blocked by the seam-less sync core).
Adopt upstream convergent files wholesale — NO for sync.ts/storage.ts (reverts single-user + e-ink architecture), MAYBE for new/index.tsx (behind a flag).
Big-bang resolution policy: take-ours-dominant + spot-adopt (recommended) vs re-review every hunk.
Merge target: cli-1.1.10 tag (recommended anchor) then the +3 main commits as the first incremental merge.
Pursue upstream seam PRs? optional/slow/external — not a dependency of the workstream.
effortEstimate: Phase 1 (lineage merge) ~1-2 days is the only near-term cost; Phases 2-4 spread across future releases and pay for themselves per merge.
